added.summary: CSS Color 5's contrast-color(<colour>) resolves to white or black, whichever has the greater WCAG 2 ratio on the colour as an opaque ground (white on a tie), so it reads at least 4.58:1 on any ground. It takes any colour, a role included (contrast-color(var(--panel)) is resolved where it is drawn and follows a scheme switch), and nests in color-mix() and relative colours.
